resources.string: Supercharge the 8-LED rear array on your Pixel 11 Pro
HiLight Plus utilizes Shizuku to safely control your Pixel\'s rear micro-LED array. Make sure Shizuku is running and authorized.
Both Favorite Contacts and Feedback Animations are enabled in System Settings. These will override your custom patterns.
Favorite Contacts is enabled in System Settings. This native feature will conflict with HiLight Plus animations.
Feedback Animations (Assistant) is enabled in System Settings and will conflict with your custom animations.
Pick a color and tap \'Test Device\' to illuminate the 8 rear LEDs, or \'Preview\' to watch on your screen.
Monitors Gemini and Google Assistant window states to illuminate the Pixel 11 rear LEDs during voice queries.
